terms.attribution: Source: Hong Kong Observatory, Hong Kong SAR Government, via DATA.GOV.HK.

date.label: Observation date
date.description: Daily date from the three source date columns.

station.label: Station
station.description: HKO: Hong Kong Observatory. This source is one station.

rainfall_mm.label: Daily rainfall
rainfall_mm.description: Exact reported numerical amount. Trace and unavailable values remain null.

raw_value.label: Original value
raw_value.description: Unchanged Value column, including Trace and ***.

quality_status.label: Completeness
quality_status.description: complete, incomplete or unknown; independent of trace/missing status.

rainfall_lower_bound_mm.label: Rainfall lower bound
rainfall_lower_bound_mm.description: Observed value or 0 for Trace. Trace is not assigned an exact measured amount.

rainfall_upper_bound_mm.label: Rainfall upper bound
rainfall_upper_bound_mm.description: Observed value or exclusive 0.05 mm for Trace, as stated in the source legend.

upper_bound_inclusive.label: Upper bound included
upper_bound_inclusive.description: False for Trace; true for exact values; null if unavailable.

source_row.label: Original CSV row
source_row.description: 1-based row, including the two title rows and column header.

unit_of_observation: One daily observation at the Hong Kong Observatory station

excluded_records.reason: Invalid Gregorian calendar date in source; date is not corrected or imputed.

scope_note: HKO station daily rainfall. Trace is below 0.05 mm and has no exact numeric value. The loaded period starts in 2019; the complete source starts in 1884. Weekly alignment is background context; catchment flow and historical publication availability have not been validated.

quality_rules.Trace: Keep null rainfall_mm and interval [0,0.05) mm
